title: UA gear picker: safer saves and recovery
lede: Keep staff choices intact through stale saves and connection failures, and make filtered gear easy to find again.

sections.heading: Persistent recovery
sections.note: Same staff fixture, search, selected size, failed save, desktop viewport, and scroll position. Components loaded from the original revision versus local edits.

pairs.title: Save conflict
pairs.beforeCap: Recovery appeared in a temporary toast overlapping the footer.
pairs.afterCap: Persistent recovery explains that reloading replaces unsaved changes.

sections.heading: Find gear again
sections.note: Same empty search and 390 × 900 viewport. Synthetic page shell; not the authenticated app shell.

pairs.title: Empty search on a narrow screen
pairs.beforeCap: The empty state only suggested changing filters. Remaining allowance was hidden.
pairs.afterCap: Show all gear resets filters directly. Remaining allowance is visible.

changes.h: Keep the save version tied to the edited list
changes.was: A background refresh could update the version while leaving older local edits in place.
changes.now: Unsaved edits retain their base version and newer server versions block saving until an explicit reload.

changes.was: Failed reads could unmount the form or clear dirty state; controls remained editable during saves.
changes.now: Failed reads retain choices, in-flight edits are blocked, and successful saves adopt the acknowledged list.

verification: 45 existing gear pricing and route tests passed.
